info.sub_ename: ENGLISH RESEARCH PROJECT DISCUSSION AND WRITING

description.sub_ename: ENGLISH RESEARCH PROJECT DISCUSSION AND WRITING
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在幫助學生培養應用學術寫作技能，教學內容包括編寫個人研究專題的完整過程，學生需確定研究問題、查詢學術文獻、收集與討論研究資料、回答研究問題，以及進行口頭報告。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to help students develop applied academic writing skills. The teaching unit includes a full process of compiling an individual research project in which students need to work on identifying research questions, locating academic sources, collecting data, discussing data to answer their research questions, and making oral presentations.

targets.describe_ch: 在學術環境中有效溝通，並創造個人研究專題。
targets.describe_en: Effectively communicate in academic settings and create an individual research project.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠解決寫作過程中遇到的問題。
targets.describe_en: Solve problems emerging in the writing process.

iSoftwares.soft_name: AI tools such as SciSpace, Research Rabbit, ChatGPT, and Jenni and apps like Conceptboard will be us
iSoftwares.soft_memo: These tools and apps will be used to promote writing efficiency.
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
We need to use Conceptboard for peer review and synchronic discussion. 
We need to use Google Doc. to brainstorm ideas, and for teachers to monitor students' participation in class discussions. 
We need to use Chatgpt to get feedback on language accuracy and (1) to see the differences between their ways of expression and the authentic expressions, (2) to know how to key in prompts to get the answers, and (3) how to find the resources and examine the credility of the resources.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en: This course aims at helping students further expand their writing skills and draft up effective essays in which unity, support and coherence are to be adroitly displayed. Students will be required to produce essays in three rhetorical modes: process, comparison and contrast, cause and effect.  For each essay, 1 preliminary draft and 1 revised draft are required. Each essay will be graded based on 4 criteria: thesis/organization,  content development,  syntax/grammar, and diction/mechanics/formatting.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
This course aims to help students develop basic writing skills to enhance unity, support, and coherence in their written work, and, above all, to improve their applied academic writing skills. Students are required to go through the research process, which encompasses several stages like identifying their research niche, searching for evidence for support, answering research questions, and presenting the results. 




Course requirements: 
1. Students need to complete the written tasks pertaining to their research by the deadlines. Unless they are excused or granted a grace period, overdue assignments will not be accepted. 
2.AI tools will be introduced as aids, and students should not transfer their learning responsibility to these tools. Copying text generated by AI tools without exercising independent judgment, or failing to properly acknowledge the use of AI tools, will be regarded as an act of plagiarism.
3. Students with five unexcused absences from classes will receive a failing grade. 
4. Students are required to attend the class on time and be fully prepared. 
5. No cell phone ringing in class

4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
